svg.title: agent-graph

g.text: LangGraph graph built by build_agent() in agent/graph.py (routes in agent/guardrails.py, agent/missing.py, agent/completion.py).
Solid arrow: add_edge. Dashed arrow: add_conditional_edges, labelled with the condition.
scope exists only when a scope guard is given and finish only with a completion guard; tools and ask only when tools are bound.
Without a guard the graph is START to model, and model goes to tools or END by tools_condition. The web program passes a scope guard and, when enabled, a completion guard (app/web_turn.py).
the turn waits for the user
